brief:
The collapse of Israeli-Palestinian peace efforts has created conditions for ongoing conflict in Gaza, the Quincy Institute reported. Decades of failed diplomatic initiatives have left the dispute unresolved, with no viable political settlement in place.

Without functional peace negotiations, the underlying territorial and political disputes driving the conflict remain unaddressed. The absence of a negotiated framework leaves few mechanisms to prevent or de-escalate violence between the parties.
dek: A Failing Peace Process Leads to Only One Outcome.
title: Gaza conflict stems from collapsed peace negotiations
